# halos_releases (Data Source)

Per-ring release pointers as verified by halo-server, with fleet convergence and drift (GET /api/v1/releases). Releases are published by CI and promoted by a human merging a PR; this data source only reads them, for example to feed monitoring or a precondition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "halos_releases" "this" {}

# Warn when any ring pointer is stale or any host drifted.
check "no_release_drift" {
  assert {
    condition     = !data.halos_releases.this.stale && alltrue([for r in data.halos_releases.this.rings : r.drift_hosts == 0])
    error_message = "a ring has drifted hosts or the registry view is stale"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `releases`.
- `registry` (String) The OCI registry the pointers are read from; empty when portal config sets none.
- `rings` (Attributes List) One entry per ring, in policy order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rings))
- `stale` (Boolean) True when the registry was unreachable and the last verified state is shown.

<a id="nestedatt--rings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rings`

Read-Only:

- `digest` (String) The release digest the ring points at.
- `drift_hosts` (Number) Hosts reporting a digest other than the ring's.
- `error` (String) Why the pointer could not be read, if it could not.
- `expired` (Boolean) Whether the pointer has expired.
- `expires_at` (String) Pointer expiry, RFC 3339; empty if unpublished.
- `hosts_on_digest` (Number) Hosts on the ring's digest.
- `hosts_on_other_digest` (Number) Hosts on another digest.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether a signed pointer exists.
- `ring` (String) Ring name.
- `seq` (Number) Pointer sequence number.
- `stale` (Boolean) Whether this ring's state is the last verified one.
- `suspicious` (Boolean) Whether the pointer failed a consistency check.
- `total_hosts` (Number) Reporting hosts.
